fields.description: Program Description Teaching Objective The aim of international politics program is cultivate international politic specialists who proficient in basic theory of international politics, world economics, and economic diplomacy. The graduates should understand the world situation changes and the international economic and trade status; skilled in diplomatic negotiation, and able to business negotiation, communication and exchanges Why Choose to Study This Program The department of international politics has taken a great number of national, provincial, and 211 research projects in the field of national soft power, regional political and economic cooperation, overseas interest protection, international immigration and international security. The department also published and issued a batch of scientific research paper, which make the department has its place in academic area. Main Courses and credits Compulsory Courses Credits Elective Courses Credits Principles of Political Science 3 Political Economy of European Union 2 Introduction to International Relations 3 Political Economy of United States 2 International Institutions and Organizations 3 Political Economy of Japan 2 International Political Economics 3 Political Economy of Developing Countries 2 Chinese Foreign Strategy and Diplomacy 3 Enterprises and Market in China 2 Chinese Political Economics 3 China's Foreign Economic Relations 2 Chinese Politics and History 3 Political Economics of Energy and Environment 2 Political Economics of Transition 3 The Political Economy of Immigrations 2 Public Leadership and Public Policy 3 Modern Diplomacy 2 Foundations of International Laws 3 Public Diplomacy 2 International Conflict and Crisis Management 3 International Strategies 2 Dissertation Seminar 3 Globalization and Global Governance 2 International Negotiations 2 International Development 2 Mao Zedong Thought and Deng Xiaoping Theory 2 Internship & Career Steigenberger Group- Hotel Management Dentsubfc-PR SwissCham Beijing- Projects Assistant & Communication Assistant Thesis (4 Credits) In the fourth year of their study, students must complete a thesis related to their major to meet the graduation requirements. The length of the thesis should be around 8000 words. The thesis is a milestone assessment on the intended level of achievement both in the major and the general learning outcomes by the students. Specifically, students, must demonstrate the ability to apply their learning to complex, unscripted problems in the context of their advanced studies, the mastery of the skills required for their disciplines as well as essential learning outcomes including the breadth and the depth of their knowledge, critical and creative thinking, problem solving, the ability to integrate knowledge and skills and present their work in an appropriate manner. Academic Calendar Fall Semester: the beginning of September to next January Spring Semester: the beginning of March to the beginning of July Summer Vacation: the beginning of July to the end of August Time Registration Time of Spring Semester : February 27-March 2 Beginning Time of Spring Semester: March 5 Note: The course requires students to pay the tuition or admission deposit before issuing the admission package.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. No Criminal Record Commitment You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Asset certificate(i.e. current deposit on the bank statement shall be able to cover program tuition) * 3. Psychological Test You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Passport photos Two recent passport photos, white background, no hat * 5. A copy of TOEFL or IELTS scores report The minimum score for TOEFL is 86 and 6.0 for IELTS. (If high school courses are taught in English, please submit the official letter about the applicant’s English proficiency). * 6. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 7. Academic transcript of Senior High School Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 8. Certificate/diploma of Senior High School Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 9. A copy of guarantor’s passport or ID * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. - You need to submit results for Mathematics and Chinese; For English taught programs just Mathematics. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. High school diploma, good health. 2. Applicants under 18 need to submit notarized guardianship certificate upon the approval of UIBE. 3. A copy of TOEFL, or IELTS, or GRE, or Cambridge International AS, A Level, IGCSE, or IB scores report, or equivalent. The minimum score for TOEFL is 86 and 6.0 for IELTS, or BBC level or above for A Level, satisfactory GRE scores, Duolingo 120 or equivalent, (If high school courses are taught in English, please provide official certificate that the teaching language was fully in English).
